about: A lightweight stand-in for AWS services, for testing on your own machine.

prs.title: Batch writes no longer crash the standard Python client
prs.broken: When every item in a batch write was saved, the reply left out a field real AWS always sends. The common Python batch writer crashed and the rest of the items were never sent.
prs.changed: The reply now always includes the field, empty when nothing is left over.
prs.matters: Code that writes data in batches works against the emulator the same as against AWS.

prs.title: Reading part of a nested record returns that part
prs.broken: Asking for a value inside a nested record or list returned nothing, as if the record did not exist.
prs.changed: Requests for nested values now pick out and return just those values, as AWS does.
prs.matters: Apps that read only part of a record get correct results when tested locally.
